changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.sql:
-- Remove legacy "ops" portal menus (运维) from portal navigation. These menus are now managed in dts-admin. -- Also remove "security.threeAdmins" (三员管理与职责分离) portal menu, which is implemented in dts-admin. WITH RECURSIVE ops_tree AS ( SELECT id FROM portal_menu WHERE parent_id IS NULL AND ( lower(name) = 'sys.nav.portal.ops' OR lower(path) = 'ops' OR (metadata IS NOT NULL AND lower(metadata) LIKE '%"sectionkey":"ops"%') ) UNION ALL SELECT m.id FROM portal_menu m JOIN ops_tree t ON m.parent_id = t.id ), three_admins_tree AS ( SELECT id FROM portal_menu WHERE ( (metadata IS NOT NULL AND lower(metadata) LIKE '%"sectionkey":"security"%' AND lower(metadata) LIKE '%"entrykey":"threeadmins"%') OR lower(name) LIKE '%threeadmins%' OR lower(path) LIKE '%three-admins%' OR lower(path) LIKE '%three_admins%' ) UNION ALL SELECT m.id FROM portal_menu m JOIN three_admins_tree t ON m.parent_id = t.id ), doomed AS ( SELECT id FROM ops_tree UNION SELECT id FROM three_admins_tree ) DELETE FROM portal_menu_visibility v WHERE v.menu_id IN (SELECT id FROM doomed);
WITH RECURSIVE ops_tree AS ( SELECT id FROM portal_menu WHERE parent_id IS NULL AND ( lower(name) = 'sys.nav.portal.ops' OR lower(path) = 'ops' OR (metadata IS NOT NULL AND lower(metadata) LIKE '%"sectionkey":"ops"%') ) UNION ALL SELECT m.id FROM portal_menu m JOIN ops_tree t ON m.parent_id = t.id ), three_admins_tree AS ( SELECT id FROM portal_menu WHERE ( (metadata IS NOT NULL AND lower(metadata) LIKE '%"sectionkey":"security"%' AND lower(metadata) LIKE '%"entrykey":"threeadmins"%') OR lower(name) LIKE '%threeadmins%' OR lower(path) LIKE '%three-admins%' OR lower(path) LIKE '%three_admins%' ) UNION ALL SELECT m.id FROM portal_menu m JOIN three_admins_tree t ON m.parent_id = t.id ), doomed AS ( SELECT id FROM ops_tree UNION SELECT id FROM three_admins_tree ) DELETE FROM portal_menu m WHERE m.id IN (SELECT id FROM doomed);
